# _index.md — global memory index

> Index for `~/.memory-os/memory/`. One line per file. `_` prefix sorts it first.
> Read this to know what's here, then open the file you need.
> PRIVATE tier — never committed. Shared by ALL of the user's Claude accounts.
> Nothing repo-specific lives here; that goes in the repo's `.claude/_memory/`.

- [me.md](me.md) — who the user is: identity, languages, machine, hard constraints
- [preferences.md](preferences.md) — how Claude should work: style, defaults, pet peeves
- [accounts.md](accounts.md) — the accounts he switches between; all the SAME person
- [journal/log.md](journal/log.md) — dated cross-project log, append-only
